scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run format && bun run lint && bun run transpile && bun run bundle
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:bench
scripts.workflow:test: bun run build && bun run test
scripts.workflow:test:unit: bun run build && bun run test:unit
scripts.workflow:test:bench: bun run build && bun run test:bench
scripts.workflow:deploy:pre: bun run build && bun run test && git add . && git commit -m 'deployment preparation' || true
scripts.workflow:deploy:major: bun run workflow:deploy:pre && npm version major && bun run workflow:deploy:post
scripts.workflow:deploy:minor: bun run workflow:deploy:pre && npm version minor && bun run workflow:deploy:post
scripts.workflow:deploy:patch: bun run workflow:deploy:pre && npm version patch && bun run workflow:deploy:post
scripts.workflow:deploy:post: (git push && bun publish) || (git push && npm login && bun publish) || (npm login && bun publish)
